app.name: Xero
app.summary: OAuth 2.0 access to a customer's Xero organisations (tenants): invoices, contacts, bank transactions, reports and payroll, depending on the scopes granted.

verdict.headline: A new Xero app is free but capped at 5 connected organisations. More than 50 needs a paid plan plus App Certification.

rationale.text: Creating the app is self-serve and takes minutes. Since 2 March 2026, though, every app starts on the free Starter plan, which allows at most 5 connected organisations. Core ($35 AUD/month) raises that to 50. Plus (1,000 connections, $245 AUD/month) and every plan above it require App Certification. Advanced and above also require a security assessment that is repeated every year. Separately, each Xero organisation can connect only a limited number of uncertified apps. Xero's developer terms also forbid using data from its APIs to train AI/ML models, which matters for an AI agent.

effort.handsOn: 30 minutes to first connection. Certification for 50+ connections takes days of build and paperwork work.
effort.approvalWait: None up to 50 connections. Certification and security review take an estimated 2-6 weeks.

basis.text: Xero publishes no turnaround time for App Certification. Its FAQ says the security assessment typically takes about 5 working days to fill in, then 5-10 working days for Xero to assess the answers, plus time for any fixes. The 2-6 week certification figure is an estimate, not a published number.

stages.name: Starter: test on your own organisations
stages.whoCanConnect: Any Xero organisation, up to 5 in total across the app

limit.text: Maximum of 5 connections, free, with a rate limit of 1,000 calls per organisation per day. Once 5 organisations are connected, the app cannot take any more until you move up a plan or disconnect some.

Paid plan ($35 AUD/month) with no certification needed. Data downloaded from the API (egress) is billed at $2.40 AUD per GB above the plan's allowance. The app is still uncertified, so each organisation's limit on uncertified apps still applies.

stages.name: Plus: certified app
stages.whoCanConnect: Up to 1,000 organisations; can be listed on the Xero App Store

limit.text: Requires App Certification, which means meeting Xero's certification checkpoints, including Sign Up with Xero. $245 AUD/month.

stages.name: Advanced / Enterprise
stages.whoCanConnect: Up to 10,000 organisations, or no limit on Enterprise

limit.text: Requires certification plus a security assessment reviewed by Xero's security team, repeated every year. Advanced is $1,445 AUD/month; Enterprise is priced on application.

steps.title: Create a Xero developer account
steps.detail: Sign in at developer.xero.com with a Xero login (create one if needed) and accept the Xero Developer Terms and Conditions. Since 4 December 2025 these terms include restrictions on how AI may use the data.
steps.doneWhen: You can see the My Apps dashboard

steps.title: Create a new app (Web app)
steps.detail: In My Apps, choose New app, pick the Web app integration type (authorization code flow with a client secret), and enter the app name your customers will see on the consent screen, your company URL and the redirect URI. Then generate a client secret on the Configuration page.
steps.doneWhen: You have a Client ID and Client secret

steps.title: Connect your own organisation
steps.detail: Run the authorization code flow against https://login.xero.com/identity/connect/authorize with the openid, offline_access and accounting scopes you need. After the token exchange, call GET https://api.xero.com/connections to get the tenantId, and send it as the Xero-tenant-id header on API calls. The Demo Company works for testing.
steps.doneWhen: An API call returns data for your tenant

steps.title: Choose a plan before passing 5 connections
steps.detail: Upgrade the app to Core in the developer portal to allow up to 50 organisations. This needs billing details.
steps.doneWhen: The app shows the Core plan

steps.title: Apply for App Certification to go past 50
steps.detail: Work through the certification checkpoints, including Sign Up with Xero / Sign In with Xero, branding, connection handling and error handling. Then apply for certification and work with your Xero Developer Evangelist. An agent can prepare the evidence and listing copy.
steps.estimate: 1-5 days of work plus Xero's review
steps.doneWhen: Xero confirms the app is certified and you can move to Plus

steps.title: Security assessment (Advanced and above, or premium features)
steps.detail: Fill in Xero's security assessment questionnaire. It typically takes about 5 working days to complete, then 5-10 working days for Xero to review, and it must be redone every year.
steps.doneWhen: Xero's security team approves the assessment

requirements.text: A Xero login and acceptance of the Xero Developer Terms and Conditions.
A paid plan beyond 5 connections: Core $35, Plus $245, Advanced $1,445 AUD/month. Egress overage is $2.40 AUD per GB.
App Certification for Plus and above, plus a yearly security assessment for Advanced and above.

OAuth endpoints, published in the discovery document at https://identity.xero.com/.well-known/openid-configuration: authorize at https://login.xero.com/identity/connect/authorize, token at https://identity.xero.com/connect/token, plus a revocation endpoint. The discovery document lists PKCE S256 and the client_credentials grant.

nuances.text: Connections count Xero organisations (tenants), not users. One user can authorise several organisations in a single consent, and each one uses up a connection.

Each Xero organisation may connect only a limited number of uncertified apps. Xero's own page says 5; one third-party guide says 2. A customer who already uses several uncertified apps may be unable to connect yours.
The developer terms ban using data from Xero's APIs to train AI/ML models. Using the data at runtime for an agent is not the same as training, but check your data pipeline against the terms.
Rate limits apply per organisation: 1,000 calls a day on Starter and 5,000 a day on Core and above.

An unknown client_id on the authorize URL sends the user to a Xero 'Error 500' page that reads 'unauthorized_client – Unknown client or client not enabled'. The error is not returned to your redirect URI.
Access tokens last about 30 minutes. Refresh tokens rotate on each use and expire after about 60 days without use, so request offline_access and refresh tokens ahead of expiry.
Apps created after March 2026 may have to use Xero's newer granular accounting scopes instead of the broad legacy ones such as accounting.transactions.

blockers.title: 5-connection cap on Starter
blockers.signal: New organisations can't connect once 5 tenants are connected. The developer portal shows the connection limit has been reached.
blockers.nextMove: Upgrade to Core (50 connections), or disconnect inactive tenants using Manage Your Connections.

blockers.title: Certification required beyond 50 organisations
blockers.signal: Plus and higher plans list App Certification as a prerequisite
blockers.nextMove: Build to the certification checkpoints, including Sign Up with Xero, early, then apply for certification.

blockers.title: Organisation-side limit on uncertified apps
blockers.signal: A customer's organisation has already connected the maximum number of uncertified apps and can't add yours
blockers.nextMove: Get certified, or ask the customer to disconnect an unused uncertified app.

agentCan: Fill in the app configuration (name, URLs, redirect URIs) and generate the OAuth requests
Call /connections and handle the Xero-tenant-id header for each tenant
Draft certification evidence, App Store listing copy and privacy text
Estimate monthly egress and suggest which plan fits
Prepare draft answers to the security assessment questionnaire for a human to review
youMust: Accept the Xero Developer Terms, which include the ban on training AI models with Xero data
Add billing details and choose a paid plan before passing 5 connections
Apply for App Certification and deal with the Xero Developer Evangelist
Complete and sign off the security assessment for Advanced and above

uncertainties.question: How long does App Certification review take in practice under the 2026 model?
uncertainties.howToResolve: Ask Xero developer support or your Developer Evangelist when you apply.

uncertainties.question: Is the per-organisation limit on uncertified apps 5 (Xero's page) or 2 (a third-party guide)?
uncertainties.howToResolve: Check the current Managing Connections page, or ask Xero support.

uncertainties.question: Do new apps have to use granular scopes, and what are the current access and refresh token lifetimes?
uncertainties.howToResolve: Read developer.xero.com/documentation/guides/oauth2/scopes and the auth flow docs.

uncertainties.question: Does an AI agent's runtime use of data (RAG or prompts) fall inside the developer terms' AI restrictions?
uncertainties.howToResolve: Read the Xero Developer Terms section on AI, and ask Xero to confirm in writing.

providerContact.channel: Xero Developer support (via developer.xero.com, under Contact / Support), or your assigned Developer Evangelist once you apply for certification
providerContact.draftMessage: Hi, we're building an AI agent that lets our customers connect their Xero organisations through OAuth 2.0 (Web app, client ID ...). We expect about N organisations in year one. Can you confirm (1) the typical turnaround for App Certification now, (2) the current per-organisation limit on uncertified apps, and (3) whether using API data at runtime in LLM prompts (with no model training) is allowed under the Developer Terms? Thanks.
